terrainDescription.zh: 由逾700座島嶼與2,500多座小島礁組成，地勢低平（多數不超過20公尺），以石灰岩地質與珊瑚礁地形為主，天然植被以熱帶灌叢為主。
terrainDescription.en: An archipelago of 700+ islands and 2,500+ cays, low-lying (mostly under 20m elevation), built on limestone and coral-reef geology, with tropical scrub as the dominant natural vegetation.

historicalContext.zh: 前英國殖民地，靠左行駛，但因地理與觀光業與美國佛羅里達州關係密切，道路速限標誌罕見地採用英里（而非其他前英國加勒比殖民地常見的公里制），是靠左行駛卻使用英制單位的少數案例。
historicalContext.en: A former British colony that drives on the left, but due to close geographic and tourism ties with Florida, speed-limit signs are unusually posted in miles rather than the kilometers common in other former British Caribbean colonies — a rare left-hand-drive-plus-imperial-units combination.
